summary: The order-update connection: connect and the order subscription t=o, the ck acknowledgement, then an order open, partly filled, complete, one rejected with Definedge's full RMS text and one cancelled, each an order_update frame with OpenAlgo's constants.

notes: RB-12: the desktop sends t=o with the connect frame, before ck; the web sends it only once ck says Ok (definedge_order_adapter.py:98-105). The frames sent upstream are not part of the web output, so the case pins the desktop's order here.
The market data socket connects too and gets its connect frame and ck.
